panel.title: Operations
panel.empty: Nothing is running. Operations appear here as work begins.

state.unknownExplanation: The effect may or may not have happened; reconciliation resolves it before any retry.

transport.staleBand: Showing last saved state — will refresh when the connection returns.

timeline.settledCounts: settled · acquired {acquired} · ordered {ordered} · enriched {enriched} · skipped {skipped} · failed {failed}

announcements.stale: Live updates paused. Showing the last saved state.
announcements.unavailable: Live updates are off. Use Refresh for the latest saved state.

errors.forbidden: This account cannot perform that action.
errors.idempotencyKeyReused: This request key was already used with different details. Send the original request or start a new one.
errors.internalServerError: The operation could not be completed.
errors.deliveryDefinitelyFailed: The provider rejected the publish. It is safe to correct the cause and retry.
errors.deliveryUnknown: The provider outcome is unknown. Reconcile it before retrying.
errors.instagramCapacityUnavailable: Instagram publishing capacity is unavailable. Retry after capacity recovers.
errors.instagramContainerExpired: The Instagram media container expired before it could be published.
errors.instagramContainerFailed: Instagram could not process the media container.
errors.instagramProcessingUnknown: Instagram has not returned a final media-processing state. Reconcile it before retrying.
errors.imageSourceExtractRequired: This RSS copy only has feed text. Refresh the article and regenerate the copy before generating an image.
errors.mediaNotPublishable: The approved media is not publishable.
errors.mediaRejected: The uploaded file failed verification and was removed.
errors.modelInvocationFailed: The model call did not complete. Its tokens and cost are recorded on the usage screen.
errors.notFound: The target of this operation is no longer available.
errors.objectStoreUnbound: Object storage is not configured for this deployment.
errors.operationReplayed: This request was already processed. The original operation is the one that ran.
errors.providerAuthFailed: The destination provider rejected this deployment's credentials.
errors.providerCapabilityUnavailable: The destination provider does not support the requested publish shape.
errors.providerRateLimited: The destination provider deferred the publish because its rate limit was reached.
errors.providerRequestInvalid: The destination provider rejected the publish request as invalid.
errors.publishPayloadTooLong: The approved copy exceeds the destination's publish limit.
errors.savedCardAlreadyActive: This draft is already saved. Open the existing saved card.
errors.sourceImportInProgress: An import is already running for this installation. Wait for it to settle, then start the next one.
errors.structuredOutputInvalid: The model returned a result that did not match the expected shape. Nothing was saved.
errors.templateDrift: The installation configuration changed while this operation was running. Reconcile the template, then send it again.
errors.telegramChannelMigrated: Telegram moved the destination channel. Update the deployment binding before retrying.
errors.telegramPostingForbidden: Telegram does not allow this deployment to post to the destination.
errors.transientConflict: The workspace was busy. Send the identical request again.
errors.unauthorized: The session ended. Sign in and send the request again.
errors.validationFailed: Some details were rejected. Correct them and send the request again.
errors.versionConflict: This operation changed while it was open. Reload to see its current state.
errors.xMediaPreparationUnknown: X media preparation did not return a known result. Retry the media preparation step; no post was sent.
